claim_comment: Defining stable provider and capability identity, authoritative revisioned registration, fail-closed capability resolution, and reserved Native/NCM/OCEAN slots before any concrete adapter is introduced.
acceptance_criteria: Provider identity and versioned capability identity are stable, canonical, and independent of runtime location or display name.
The registry resolves an explicitly selected provider by required capabilities and fails closed for unknown, duplicate, disabled, reserved, unavailable, incompatible, cancelled, or timed-out states.
Provider-name branching is confined to registry/adapter construction; public transports, context, storage, and application surfaces remain provider-neutral with no silent fallback.
TraceDecay Native, NCM, and OCEAN have explicit bootstrap slots; NCM topology remains deferred and OCEAN reserves identity without claiming implementation.
close_reason: Accepted the V1 provider identity, capability catalog, registration, and fail-closed resolution contract with explicit Native/NCM/OCEAN bootstrap slots and no concrete adapter or silent fallback.
close_comment: Evidence: product/contracts/memory-provider-v1/provider-registry-contract.json and its strict JSON Schema define canonical MemoryProviderIdV1 identity, versioned capability IDs, nine provider-neutral behavior capabilities, TraceDecay-owned revisioned registration, exact selection requests carrying scope/revision/request/deadline/cancellation, fourteen typed resolution states, and zero-or-one active provider per exact scope. Only registry/composition may branch on provider_id; every capability is advisory and cannot mutate TraceDecay canonical authorities. Bootstrap slots reserve tracedecay.native, ncm, and ocean without counting any as implemented: Native remains gated by parity, NCM capabilities/topology by tdmem-0701/0702, and OCEAN has no speculative implementation gates. scripts/product/check-provider-registry-contract.py validates regex identity, catalog completeness, Beads references, authority limits, registration/selection invariants, strict schema, M0/ADR dependencies, no fallback, deferred NCM topology, and OCEAN reservation. tests/product_provider_registry_contract_test.py rejects duplicate/unversioned capabilities, canonical mutation, self-registration, public provider-name branching, missing deadline/cancellation, silent fallback, empty success, hidden unknown-provider outcomes, duplicate slots, premature NCM topology, reordered NCM gates, speculative OCEAN implementation, premature Native implementation, unknown verification beads, and schema weakening.
